_note: The Canadian Highlander Council as of the Fall 2026 update and the September 2026 council change. Photos are the public profile pictures each person uses on Moxfield; anyone without one gets a monogram. Sources are on canadianhighlander.ca.

members.name: Benjamin Wheeler
members.role: The voice of the points updates
members.bio: Posts the council's announcements and walks through the changes in the council's points-update videos. Won 2014's Highlander for Staples at Yellowjacket with mono-green Craterhoof, and is a regular voice on LoadingReadyRun's North 100.

members.name: Robin Sorensen
members.bio: Named on the official site among the players who got the format off the ground in Victoria. There's a blue-green tempo deck that carries his name: "UG Sorensen."

members.name: Spencer Kanaka
members.bio: One of the five councillors who steered the format through 2025, before the council grew. Every vote is published by name, and his include being the lone yes on pointing Demonic Counsel in the Fall 2026 update.

members.name: Evan Pepper
members.role: Write-ups and the reasoning behind them
members.bio: Co-wrote the March 2026 points update with Josh and Kelvin, laying out why each card moved. One of the five councillors before the 2026 expansion.

members.name: Kelvin Chen
members.role: Data, tournaments, and the manabase guide
members.bio: Voted in when the council expanded to represent the Discord and international players. Organizes tournaments, gathers the data behind points decisions, and wrote the official guides to singleton manabases and deck-building questions.

members.name: Joshua Gottlieb
members.bio: Voted in alongside Kelvin as one of the first councillors from outside Victoria. Runs events, made format information easier to find, and led the March 2026 write-up.

members.name: Trenton M.
members.bio: A Victoria regular who wins events with a smile. Makes Canadian Highlander videos with Liam and Jer on LJT MTG, and has piloted everything from Jeskai and Jund to Cradlehoof, Mono Red and Flash Hulk.
